cdm.none.en: Coins and VIP numbers arrive with the next crazydramas release.
cdm.none.zh: 金币和 VIP 数据将随 crazydramas 下一次发布到来。

cdm.scopeNote.en: Payments are not split by phone or country, so those filters do not apply on this tab.
cdm.scopeNote.zh: 付款不按手机或国家拆分，因此这两个筛选在本页不适用。

cdm.cashInfo.en: Every payment in the period, on the day it was paid, before Stripe's fees: coin packs, VIP and series. Refunded payments are included here and shown apart under Refunds.
cdm.cashInfo.zh: 该时段内的每笔付款（按付款日计，未扣 Stripe 手续费）：金币包、VIP 和剧集。已退款的付款也计入此处，另在“退款”中单列。

cdm.refundsInfo.en: Payments refunded or disputed since, counted on the day they were paid (the ledger keeps no refund date).
cdm.refundsInfo.zh: 此后被退款或争议的付款，按付款日计（账本不记录退款日期）。

cdm.payersInfo.en: Different people who paid in the period (all browsers that paid with one email count as one person). Refunded payments left out.
cdm.payersInfo.zh: 该时段内付费的不同人数（用同一邮箱付款的所有浏览器算一人）。已退款的付款不计。

cdm.payerRateInfo.en: People whose first payment of all was in the period, as a share of the people who watched for the first time in the period. With a filter picked: of the people who opened a series in it.
cdm.payerRateInfo.zh: 首次付款发生在该时段的人数，占该时段首次观看人数的比例。选择筛选时：占其中打开剧集的人数。

cdm.perPayerInfo.en: Cash taken less refunds, divided by the people who paid.
cdm.perPayerInfo.zh: 收款减去退款，除以付费人数。

cdm.toPayInfo.en: The middle time from a person's first visit to their first payment of all.
cdm.toPayInfo.zh: 从首次访问到首次付款的中位用时。

cdm.chart.en: Money per day, by what was bought

cdw.viewsInfo.en: How often the unlock sheet was shown (views, not people).
cdw.viewsInfo.zh: 解锁面板的展示次数（次数，不是人数）。

cdw.convInfo.en: Payments made from the unlock sheet, divided by its views.
cdw.convInfo.zh: 从解锁面板完成的付款数，除以面板展示次数。

cdw.unlocksInfo.en: Episodes opened with coins, by hand or by auto-unlock.
cdw.unlocksInfo.zh: 用金币打开的集数（手动或自动解锁）。

cdw.firstWeekInfo.en: New viewers who took Weekly VIP's $1.99 first week.
cdw.firstWeekInfo.zh: 选择周 VIP $1.99 首周的新观众。

cdw.firstPackInfo.en: New viewers who bought the first-time $4.99 pack (500 + 75 coins).
cdw.firstPackInfo.zh: 购买首次 $4.99 金币包（500 + 75 金币）的新观众。

cdw.notCompletedInfo.en: Times a viewer came back from Stripe's page without paying and saw the “Payment not completed” pop-up.
cdw.notCompletedInfo.zh: 观众从 Stripe 页面返回但未付款、看到“付款未完成”弹窗的次数。

cdw.tableInfo.en: Shown: sheet views and pop-ups shown. Checkouts: Stripe's page opened from it. Paid: payments made from it (older payments without a screen count as the sheet's; VIP renewals left out). The store page has no view count.
cdw.tableInfo.zh: 展示：面板展示和弹窗展示次数。结账：从此处打开 Stripe 页面的次数。付费：从此处完成的付款（未记录来源的旧付款计入面板；VIP 续费不计）。金币商店页面没有展示次数。

cdvip.activeInfo.en: VIP subscriptions on today: weekly, monthly and yearly. Today's number, whatever the period.
cdvip.activeInfo.zh: 今天有效的 VIP 订阅（周、月、年）。无论选择哪个时段，都是今天的数字。

cdvip.mrrInfo.en: What the paying subscriptions on today bring in a month: a weekly one at 52/12 of its week, a yearly one at a twelfth. $1.99 first weeks are left out until they renew.
cdvip.mrrInfo.zh: 今天有效的付费订阅每月带来的收入：周订阅按每周价格 × 52/12，年订阅按十二分之一。$1.99 首周在续费前不计。

cdvip.introsInfo.en: Subscriptions still in their $1.99 first week today.
cdvip.introsInfo.zh: 今天仍处于 $1.99 首周的订阅。

cdvip.introRateInfo.en: Of the $1.99 first weeks that ran out in the period (by yesterday), the share that renewed at the full price.
cdvip.introRateInfo.zh: 该时段内（截至昨天）到期的 $1.99 首周中，以原价续费的比例。

cdvip.newInfo.en: Subscriptions begun in the period: at the $1.99 first week and at full price.
cdvip.newInfo.zh: 该时段内开始的订阅：$1.99 首周和原价。

cdvip.endedInfo.en: Subscriptions that ended in the period: their paid time ran out without a renewal (cancelled or unpaid), or they were stopped early (refund or dispute).
cdvip.endedInfo.zh: 该时段结束的订阅：付费期结束且未续费（取消或未付款），或被提前终止（退款或争议）。

cdcoin.boughtInfo.en: Paid coins in the packs bought in the period; the packs' bonus coins apart.
cdcoin.boughtInfo.zh: 该时段购买的金币包中的付费金币；赠送金币另计。

cdcoin.spentInfo.en: Coins spent on episodes in the period, paid and bonus together. Bonus coins go first.
cdcoin.spentInfo.zh: 该时段用于解锁剧集的金币（付费与赠送合计）。优先消耗赠送金币。

cdcoin.rewardInfo.en: Reward coins claimed in Rewards (check-in, watching, tasks). They bring no revenue.
cdcoin.rewardInfo.zh: 在奖励页领取的金币（签到、观看、任务）。不产生收入。

cdcoin.unspentInfo.en: Paid coins in viewers' wallets now, at what viewers paid for them: money taken for episodes not watched yet. Today's number, whatever the period.
cdcoin.unspentInfo.zh: 观众钱包里目前的付费金币，按观众支付的价格计算：已收款但尚未观看的剧集。无论选择哪个时段，都是今天的数字。

cdcoin.expiredInfo.en: Bonus and reward coins that ran out unspent in the period.
cdcoin.expiredInfo.zh: 该时段内未使用而过期的赠送和奖励金币。

cdcoin.repeatInfo.en: Of the people who bought coins in the period, the share who have bought more than one pack.
cdcoin.repeatInfo.zh: 该时段购买金币的人中，购买过不止一个金币包的比例。

cdcoin.chart.en: Coins in and out per day

cdo.firstPayersInfo.en: People whose first payment of all was in the period. A second coin pack is not a new payer.
cdo.firstPayersInfo.zh: 首次付款发生在该时段的人数。第二次购买金币包不算新付费用户。

cdo.perFirstInfo.en: Ad spend divided by the new payers who came from ads.
cdo.perFirstInfo.zh: 广告花费除以来自广告的新付费用户数。

cdo.cashInfo.en: Cash taken in the period less refunds, before Stripe's fees: coin packs, VIP and series, on the day each was paid.
cdo.cashInfo.zh: 该时段收款减去退款（未扣 Stripe 手续费）：金币包、VIP 和剧集，按付款日计。

cdc.col.d0Info.en: What the campaign's viewers paid by the end of the day they first came (coins counted where they were spent), divided by spend.
cdc.col.d0Info.zh: 该广告系列的观众在首次到来当天结束前的付费（金币按实际消费计），除以花费。

cdc.col.d7Info.en: What the campaign's viewers paid within 7 days of the day they first came (coins counted where they were spent), divided by spend. Viewers who came less than 7 days ago are still adding to it.
cdc.col.d7Info.zh: 该广告系列的观众在首次到来后 7 天内的付费（金币按实际消费计），除以花费。7 天内新来的观众仍在累计中。

cdx.col.coinsInfo.en: Paid coins spent on the series' episodes in the period, at 1¢ a coin (already inside Revenue). Bonus and reward coins count nothing.
cdx.col.coinsInfo.zh: 该时段用于解锁本剧的付费金币，按每枚 1 美分计（已计入收入）。赠送和奖励金币不计。

cdm.wholeSite.en: These numbers are for all of CrazyDramas: the series, phone, source and country filters don't apply to them.
cdm.wholeSite.zh: 这些数字涵盖整个 CrazyDramas：剧集、手机、来源和国家筛选对其不适用。

cdm.seriesNote.en: Coin packs belong to no series, so they are not here. Coins spent on this series in the period: {cash} (in its revenue on the Series tab).
cdm.seriesNote.zh: 金币包不属于任何剧集，因此不在此处。该时段在本剧消费的金币：{cash}（计入剧集页的收入）。

cdo.creditInfo.en: With a filter picked: what those viewers brought in: series unlocks, the VIP they took and the paid coins they spent on episodes (1¢ a coin), before Stripe's fees, refunds left out. The same money as the Series and Campaigns tabs, counted on the day each viewer first opened the series.
cdo.creditInfo.zh: 选择筛选时：这些观众带来的收入：剧集解锁、开通的 VIP，以及在剧集上消费的付费金币（每枚 1 美分），未扣 Stripe 手续费，不含退款。与剧集和广告系列页相同，按观众首次打开剧集的日期计。
